renderNote: Rated on r11v/r11p/r11st/r11q (renders 17:11 UTC, HEAD ee521f1 + the w11 cameras in dbb98b5). They include the w10 commit 2b060c7 (door-3 barSoffit closures over the cove/grille/bin-crest ends, crest groove at x 0.724 / 18 mm). The working tree holds an uncommitted 08_bins.js paintBinDecals change (framed seat glyph + person). It is NOT in these renders: r11p/v6 still shows '33' followed by three seat strokes, so it was not rated. The door 1/2/4/5 cross-aisle ceilings are rated for the first time (d1*, d2*, d4*, d5*). They have no photo check, so they were judged for plausibility and for consistency with the aisle vault and the verified door-3 soffit. The aisle ceiling scores are essentially unchanged from w10. Lighting notes (not scored): the bins still clip to near-white in q06/q13/q16, and fore-aft vault streaks remain (r11p/v12, x 1100-1400).

issues.detail: Door 1/2/4/5 domes are flat, unshaded and brighter than the aisle vault
issues.problem: The light door domes render as one uniform tone with no falloff, no AO and no joints. A 200x100 px patch of the d1 dome reads exactly 229 everywhere (min = max = 229), and so do d4b and d5b. The aisle vault next to them reads 178 (v1, v2), with the baked grille-to-crease falloff. The door zones therefore read as glowing, featureless placeholder boxes, unlike the detailed vault on either side. Real 777 door-area ceilings use the same panel material as the vault, with visible panel joints and the same soft shading.
issues.fix: src/07b_ceiling.js door branch (l.288-293): after the DOME gSweep, bake the same falloff used for the vault (f = lerp(0.85, 0.66, clamp((xg - |x|)/(xg - 0.735), 0, 1)), applied per vertex as at l.255-259) onto the dome vertices. Drop the eFn base from 0.07 to about 0.02 so the shadow/AO terms can act. Add transverse joint ribs at z0 + 0.02 and z1 - 0.02, plus one at zc for zones longer than 1 m, using the existing vault rib material/profile. Target: dome centre about 0.95x the adjacent vault crest, with a visible gradient toward the shoulders.

issues.detail: Door 2: the dark passage soffit floats under a white dome, and the two files disagree about door 2
issues.problem: 10_mono.js passageSoffit draws a dark slab (L 65) at y 2.13 across the door-2 passage. 07b_ceiling.js still sweeps a light dome above it (beyond the slab's far edge: L 253, blown out). The slab ends in a hard straight edge with no fascia, trim or step, and the white curved dome shoulders show behind it on both sides. In c133/c134 the dark soffit has a metallic edge trim and a vertical return down to a lighter header. d2 (looking forward) shows a cluttered stack under the door-2 EXIT sign: white arch, grey band 223, white plank 237 (the 1.30 m header box), grey band 223-229, then the dark slab 94-106. The source is also unclear: 07b says the c133/c134 dark tray is door 3 (the bar), while 10_mono cites the same lalf_133/134 photos for the door-2 galley passage.
issues.fix: src/07b_ceiling.js door branch: for zn.door === 1 (where 10_mono adds a passage soffit), give the DOME sweep CEILMAT.barSoffit, as at door 3, and skip the entry light strips there. Alternatively, add a 0.10-0.30 m vertical fascia (CEILMAT.barFrame on the dark side, CEILMAT.flat outside) from y 2.13 up to the dome along the slab's fore/aft edges. Ask the monuments owner (10_mono.js) to add a 15 mm metallic edge trim on the slab. Resolve with the user which door c133/c134 show (see questions).

issues.problem: Apart from two strip lights and two downlights, the door domes are empty. A 777 door/galley/lav area ceiling normally shows a PA speaker, an emergency light, a smoke detector next to the lavatories, and often attendant/lav-occupied indicators. The aisle vault next door has a speaker and an emergency light, so the door zones look less finished than the zones on either side.
